english.title: Destroy valuable security or document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) dishonestly, with a view to gain for yourself or another or with intent to cause loss to another destroyed

(A)_[a valuable security, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SECURITY..)]_
(B)_[an original document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..), of or belonging to a Court of Justice, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..)]_
(C)_[an original document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..), of or belonging to a Government Department, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEPARTMENT..)]_
(D)_[an original document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..), filed or deposited in a Court of Justice, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..)]_
(E)_[an original document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..), filed or deposited in a Government Department, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEPARTMENT..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(1) of the Theft Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
